title: LaHave River Campground

services.name: Tiny Cabins
services.desc: Our Tiny Cabins offer a rustic yet comfortable camping experience. LaHave hosts 7 Tiny Cabins, all of which offer a simple 10x12 floor plan with two double beds, a mini fridge, microwave, fan, small table and chair set, a deck, picnic table, firepit, 20-amp power, and an outdoor water tap. Accommodating up to 2 adults and 2 children, these pet-friendly cabins make it easy to enjoy nature with added comfort. There are some unique features to consider when deciding which cabin to book. Cabins 4, 14, 43, and 51 are located on the main level of the campground, while cabins 52, 53, and 54 sit up on a modest hill. services.name: Rental Trailers
services.desc: Our Rental Trailers allow you to experience the great outdoors, with some of the comforts of home! We have 2 Rental Trailers at LaHave; both of which are 24 feet with the same great floorplan. They are situated side-by-side on the main level of the campground, in close proximity to our store, playground, and swimming holes. Outside, you will be equipped with a deck with an awning, a patio set, a small outdoor kitchen, and a fire pit. Indoors, you will have the comforts of a queen bed, and open concept kitchen and living room with a large dinette, two double bunk beds, a bathroom with shower, a furnace, air conditioning, and 30-amp service. blurb: Our quaint family owned and operated campground can be found in Lunenburg County, Nova Scotia, nestled in a forested area along the LaHave River. Enjoy the peaceful sights and sounds of nature amidst a small, welcoming community of campers that enjoy activities for all ages.
